name: Corner Wipe
description: The first clip shrinks into a corner of the frame with hard edges, the second clip takes the rest. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: corner
params.description: The corner the first clip shrinks into: 0 = top-left (xfade wipetl), 1 = top-right (wipetr), 2 = bottom-left (wipebl), 3 = bottom-right (wipebr)
